verdict.rationale: Pricing, renewal and exit terms are a fair question for a registered-agent and entity-management service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only SOP handling, compliance calendars, filings and APIs. It has nothing on renewal charges, cancellation terms, or transferring the registered agent out to another provider.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, renewal charges and cancellation or transfer-out terms are documented, so leaving the service does not strand the entity
